head: DuckDuckGo browser on Windows now supports Bitwarden and LastPass
dek: DuckDuckGo's Windows browser now lets you add password manager extensions, starting with Bitwarden and LastPass. Mac support is in the works.
details: You don't need a Google account to install them, even though the button takes you to the Chrome Web Store. Users have asked for more, such as 1Password and Proton Pass.
means: If you use Bitwarden or LastPass, you can now use DuckDuckGo's browser without copying passwords by hand.
todo: In DuckDuckGo, open Settings > Password Manager Extensions and click Get next to yours.
